headline: Content strategy and digital marketing that drives measurable growth.
intro: I help creatives, small businesses and brands turn content, data and digital platforms into leads and engagement. Independent consulting in digital marketing, content strategy, communications and business development, based in Barcelona and working in English and Spanish.

services.title: Digital marketing
services.description: SEO, conversion optimisation, UX and marketing automation, with decisions led by data and tested before they scale.

services.title: Content strategy
services.description: Content plans, editorial pipelines and scalable content systems that keep a brand consistent across markets and channels.

services.title: Communications
services.description: Messaging, tone of voice and storytelling, from audience research to the finished copy and the people who write it.

services.title: Business development
services.description: Aligning websites, content and product roadmaps with commercial goals: lead generation, go-to-market plans and agency management.

about_body:
I lead global digital platforms and marketing content at Wall Street English, where I have worked since 2013, moving from educational content into marketing content and now global web platform strategy. That means running a roadmap, a cross-functional team and a network of agencies, and reporting results to senior management.

Before that I worked in education, music and events, and spent several years as a policy adviser and private secretary to UK government ministers. That mix gives me an unusual range: I can write for a learner, pitch to a minister or brief a development agency.

I am a native English speaker with professional working Spanish.
